tools.name: rmbg_remove_background
tools.description: Remove the background from an image using RMBG-1.4 (public model; RMBG-2.0 is gated), returning a PNG with a transparent background. Works on photos, illustrations, and screenshots. Ideal for compositing subjects onto new backgrounds before image-to-video generation.

src.description: Path to the input image (JPEG, PNG, WebP, etc.)

dest.description: Output PNG path (optional — a temp file is used if omitted)

tools.name: rmbg_is_available
tools.description: Return true if the rmbg plugin's required packages (torch, torchvision, transformers) are installed
